info.name: Capstone NestJS API
info.description:
Complete Postman Collection v2.1 generated directly from the `kishankumarCTS/capstone` NestJS repository.

### Architecture
- **Framework:** NestJS (Express) with global `ValidationPipe` on port `3000` (configurable via `PORT` in `.env`)
- **Database:** PostgreSQL via TypeORM (`users`, `refresh_tokens`, `workspaces`, `workspace-members`, `projects`, `tasks`, `comments`)
- **Auth:** `@nestjs/authentication` Bearer JWT (`JwtBearerProvider`) globally enforced unless marked `@Public()`
- **RBAC:** `RolesGuard` with `UserRoles` (`owner`, `member`)
- **Caching & Queues:** Redis (`localhost:6379`) for project/task caching and BullMQ (`task-assignment`)
- **WebSockets (Non-HTTP):** `TaskGateway` (Socket.IO) exposes `joinTaskAssigned`, `assigned`, and `leaveTaskAssigned` events (not included as REST requests).

### Quick Start
1. Import both `capstone.postman_collection.json` and `capstone.postman_environment.json`.
2. Select the **Capstone Local Environment**.
3. Run **Auth -> Register User** (saves `userId`) and **Auth -> Login** (saves `accessToken` and `refreshToken`).
4. Run **Workspaces -> Create Workspace** -> **Projects -> Create Project** -> **Tasks -> Create Task** -> **Task Comments -> Add Comment**. Test scripts automatically capture IDs (`workspaceId`, `projectId`, `taskId`, `commentId`) for downstream requests.

request.description:
Returns the default NestJS greeting from `AppController.getHello()`.

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT required (route is not decorated with `@Public()`).
- **Expected Status:** `200 OK`
- **Expected Response:** Plain text `Hello World!`

item.name: Auth

request.description:
Registers a new user account (`AuthController.register`).

- **Auth:** Public (`@Public()`)
- **Validation (`RegisterDto`):**
  - `email` (string, valid email, required, unique)
  - `password` (string, required)
  - `role` (enum: `owner` | `member`, required)
- **Expected Statuses:** `201 Created`, `400 Bad Request` (validation error), `409 Conflict` (`User already exists.`)
- **Expected Response:** `{ "message": "User created", "user_id": "<uuid>" }`

Authenticates an existing user and issues JWT access & refresh tokens (`AuthController.login`).

- **Auth:** Public (`@Public()`)
- **Validation (`LoginDto`):**
  - `email` (string, valid email, required)
  - `password` (string, required)
- **Expected Statuses:** `201 Created`, `400 Bad Request`, `401 Unauthorized` (`Email or password was incorrect.`)
- **Expected Response:** Token object from `@nestjs/authentication` containing `accessToken` and `refreshToken`.

Issues a new token pair using an active refresh token (`AuthController.refresh`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT required (route is NOT decorated with `@Public()`).
- **Body (`RefreshTokenDto`):** `{ "refreshToken": "<token>" }`
- **Expected Statuses:** `201 Created`, `401 Unauthorized` (invalid, revoked, or expired refresh token).
- **Implementation Note:** `AuthService.refresh()` reads `tokenDetails.user.id` without specifying `relations: { user: true }` in `refreshTokenRepository.findOne()`, which may trigger a runtime error unless the `user` relation is loaded.

Deletes the hashed refresh token from the database (`AuthController.logout`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT required (route is NOT decorated with `@Public()`).
- **Body (`RefreshTokenDto`):** `{ "refreshToken": "<token>" }`
- **Expected Status:** `201 Created`
- **Expected Response:** `{ "message": "User logged out." }`

item.description: Authentication endpoints (`src/auth/auth.controller.ts`): register, login, refresh token, and logout.

item.name: Workspaces

request.description:
Fetches workspaces (`WorkspacesController.findAll`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required)
- **Expected Status:** `200 OK`
- **Expected Response:** `{ "message": "All workspaces fetched successfully", "data": [] }` (currently returns a static empty array in `WorkspacesService.findAll()`).

Creates a new workspace owned by the authenticated user (`WorkspacesController.create`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required)
- **Validation (`CreateWorkspaceDto`):** `name` (string, required)
- **Expected Statuses:** `201 Created`, `400 Bad Request`, `401 Unauthorized`, `403 Forbidden`
- **Expected Response (`WorkspaceResponseDto`):** `{ "id": "<uuid>", "name": "...", "owner": "<userId>", "createdAt": "<iso-date>" }`

Fetches a single workspace owned by the authenticated user (`WorkspacesController.findOne`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required; must be workspace owner)
- **Path Parameter:** `id` (Workspace UUID)
- **Expected Statuses:** `200 OK`, `404 Not Found` (`Workspace not found`)
- **Expected Response (`WorkspaceResponseDto`):** `{ "id", "name", "owner", "createdAt" }`

Updates the name of a workspace owned by the authenticated user (`WorkspacesController.update`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required; must be workspace owner)
- **Path Parameter:** `id` (Workspace UUID)
- **Validation (`UpdateWorkspaceDto`):** `name` (string, required)
- **Expected Statuses:** `200 OK`, `400 Bad Request`, `404 Not Found` (`Worspace not found.`)
- **Expected Response (`WorkspaceResponseDto`):** `{ "id", "name", "owner", "createdAt" }`

Deletes a workspace owned by the authenticated user (`WorkspacesController.remove`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required; must be workspace owner)
- **Path Parameter:** `id` (Workspace UUID)
- **Expected Statuses:** `200 OK`, `404 Not Found` (`Workspace not found`)
- **Expected Response:** `{ "message": "Workspace deleted successfully" }`

item.description: Workspace management endpoints (`src/workspaces/workspaces.controller.ts`). All routes require Bearer JWT and `owner` role (`@UseGuards(RolesGuard)`, `@Roles(UserRoles.OWNER)`).

item.name: Projects

request.description:
Creates a new project inside a workspace (`ProjectsController.createProject`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required)
- **Validation (`CreateProjectDto`):**
  - `name` (string, required)
  - `workspaceId` (string, required)
- **Expected Statuses:** `201 Created`, `400 Bad Request`
- **Expected Response:** `{ "id": <auto-increment-id>, "name": "...", "workspace": "<workspaceId>" }`

request.description:
Fetches a single project owned by the authenticated user's workspace (`ProjectsController.findProject`). Cached in Redis (`capstone:project:<project_id>`) for 60 seconds.

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required; must own parent workspace)
- **Path Parameter:** `project_id`
- **Expected Statuses:** `200 OK`, `404 Not Found` (`Project not found.`)
- **Expected Response:** `{ "id": ..., "name": "..." }`

Updates a project's name (`ProjectsController.updateProject`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required; must own parent workspace)
- **Path Parameter:** `id` (Project ID)
- **Validation (`UpdateProjectDto`):** `name` (string, required)
- **Expected Statuses:** `200 OK`, `400 Bad Request`, `404 Not Found` (`Project not found.`)
- **Expected Response:** Updated `Project` entity.

Deletes a project owned by the authenticated user's workspace (`ProjectsController.removeProject`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required; must own parent workspace)
- **Path Parameter:** `project_id`
- **Expected Statuses:** `200 OK`, `404 Not Found` (`Project not found`)
- **Expected Response:** `{ "message": "Project removed." }`

item.description: Project management endpoints (`src/projects/projects.controller.ts`). All routes require Bearer JWT and `owner` role (`@UseGuards(RolesGuard)`, `@Roles(UserRoles.OWNER)`).

item.name: Tasks

query.description: Sort column: createdAt | updatedAt | dueDate | title | priority | status (required in practice; omitting triggers default 'ASC' which fails validation)
Filter by status: todo | in_progress | done
Filter by priority: low | medium | high

request.description:
Lists tasks with optional filters, sorting, and pagination (`TasksController.findAll`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required)
- **Query Parameters:**
  - `page` (int, default `1`, must be `>= 1`)
  - `limit` (int, default `10`, must be `1..100`)
  - `sortBy` (string: `createdAt` | `updatedAt` | `dueDate` | `title` | `priority` | `status`). **Important:** In `TasksService.findAll()`, omitting `sortBy` defaults to `'ASC'`, which fails the `allowedSortFields` check and throws `400 Invalid sortBy field`.
  - `projectId` (optional), `status` (`todo` | `in_progress` | `done`), `priority` (`low` | `medium` | `high`), `assigneeId` (optional UUID)
- **Expected Statuses:** `200 OK`, `400 Bad Request`
- **Expected Response:** `{ "data": [...], "pagination": { "total", "page", "limit", "totalPages", "hasNextPage", "hasPreviousPage" } }`

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Implement JWT refresh rotation",
  "description": "Add refresh token rotation and revocation checks in AuthService",
  "status": "todo",
  "priority": "high",
  "dueDate": "2026-12-31T23:59:59.000Z",
  "projectId": "{{projectId}}",
  "assignee": "{{userId}}"
}

request.description:
Creates a new task under a project (`TasksController.createTask`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required)
- **Validation (`CreateTaskDto`):**
  - `title` (string, required)
  - `description` (string, required)
  - `status` (enum: `todo` | `in_progress` | `done`, required)
  - `priority` (enum: `low` | `medium` | `high`, required)
  - `dueDate` (ISO 8601 date string, required)
  - `projectId` (string, required)
  - `assignee` (string user UUID; optional in DTO, but `TasksService.create()` looks up the user and throws `404 Assignee not found.` if missing/invalid)
- **Expected Statuses:** `201 Created`, `400 Bad Request`, `404 Not Found` (`Project not found.` or `Assignee not found.`)
- **Expected Response:** Created `Task` entity.

Fetches a single task by UUID (`TasksController.findOneTask`). Cached in Redis (`capsote:task:<id>`) for 60 seconds.

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` or `member` role allowed)
- **Path Parameter:** `id` (Task UUID)
- **Expected Statuses:** `200 OK`, `404 Not Found` (`Task not found.`)
- **Expected Response:** `Task` entity.

Updates a task (`TasksController.updateTask`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` or `member` role allowed)
  - **`owner`:** Can update any task with `title`, `description`, `status`, `priority`, `dueDate`, and `assigneeId`.
  - **`member`:** Can only update tasks assigned to them; only `description`, `status`, and `priority` are applied (also enqueues BullMQ `notify-subscribers` job).
- **Path Parameter:** `id` (Task UUID)
- **Validation (`UpdateTaskDto` — all fields optional):**
  - `title` (string)
  - `description` (string)
  - `status` (`todo` | `in_progress` | `done`)
  - `priority` (`low` | `medium` | `high`)
  - `dueDate` (ISO 8601 date string)
  - `assigneeId` (UUID)
- **Expected Statuses:** `200 OK`, `400 Bad Request`, `404 Not Found` (`Task not found.` or `Assignee not found.`)

Deletes a task by UUID (`TasksController.deleteTask`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required)
- **Path Parameter:** `id` (Task UUID)
- **Expected Statuses:** `200 OK`, `404 Not Found` (`Task not found`)
- **Expected Response:** `{ "message": "Task deleted" }`

item.description: Task CRUD, filtering, and pagination endpoints (`src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts`). Controller default role is `owner`; `GET /tasks/:id` and `PATCH /tasks/:id` allow both `owner` and `member`.

item.name: Task Comments

request.description:
Retrieves all comments for a given task (`TasksController.getComments`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required — inherits class-level `@Roles(UserRoles.OWNER)`)
- **Path Parameter:** `id` (Task UUID)
- **Expected Statuses:** `200 OK`, `404 Not Found` (`Task not found.`)
- **Expected Response:** Array of `Comment` entities.

Adds a comment to a task authored by the authenticated user (`TasksController.addComment`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` or `member` role allowed)
- **Path Parameter:** `id` (Task UUID)
- **Validation (`AddCommentDto`):** `body` (string, required)
- **Expected Statuses:** `201 Created`, `400 Bad Request`, `404 Not Found` (`Task not found`)
- **Expected Response:** Created `Comment` entity.

Deletes a comment on a task (`TasksController.deleteComment`).

- **Auth:** Bearer JWT (`owner` role required)
- **Path Parameters:** `id` (Task UUID), `comment_id` (Comment UUID)
- **Expected Statuses:** `200 OK`, `404 Not Found` (`Task not found` or `Comment not found`)
- **Expected Response:** `{ "message": "Comment deleted" }`
- **Implementation Note:** In `src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts`, `deleteComment(@Param('id') id: string, comment_id: string)` is missing the `@Param('comment_id')` decorator on the second parameter, so `comment_id` will be `undefined` at runtime until fixed in source.

item.description: Comment endpoints mounted under `/tasks/:id/comments` (`src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts`). Note: `src/comments/comments.controller.ts` defines no routes.
